summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running. `main.py` imported from a nonexistent `greetings` module instead of `greeter`, and `greeter.py` had a `def greet(name)` missing its colon. After both fixes, the program runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!`
